policy.claim_rule: A SOTA claim is always bounded to an exact task scope, population, benchmark digest, dataset digest, and source revision.
policy.metric_rule: Every declared metric is non-compensable and evaluated in its declared maximize/minimize direction; aggregate-only qualification is forbidden.
policy.contamination_rule: Qualification requires a clean contamination status bound to an immutable audit digest.
policy.replay_rule: Qualification requires an exact independent replay from a verifier identity and verifier family distinct from the generator.
policy.authority_rule: Qualification is evaluation evidence only and cannot deploy, promote, route traffic, or mark masterplan completion.
